name: Annnimate
summary: Paid library of 115 GSAP motion components for React, Vue and HTML, each shipped on real brand work and tuned with data attributes.
description: Motion component library by studio Good Fella: 115 GSAP components across buttons, scroll, UI, experimental, shader and menu categories, each one first shipped on a real brand site or held to the same bar. Components are copy-paste code for React (useGSAP), Vue (composable) and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, tuned with data-anm-* attributes or typed props, with reduced-motion handling and Next.js/Nuxt readiness. Free components ship weekly; the paid Library covers new components and updates, and Landmark Kits (Reveal, Menu) are one-time purchases.
contains: 115 components in six categories: buttons, scroll, UI, experimental, shader, menu
copy-paste React, Vue and HTML/CSS/JS; explicitly not an npm package
tuned with data-anm-* attributes or typed React and Vue props
free Starter Pack plus a new free component every week
Library from €29/month (quarterly) or €249/year Solo; Studio and Studio+ tiers
Landmark Kits one-time: Reveal (preloaders and heroes), Menu (ten navigation menus)
prefers-reduced-motion handled; Server Component safe, Next.js App Router and Nuxt ready
14-day money-back guarantee; unlimited commercial client projects, no attribution
